_doc: Hand-maintained data manifest (reviewed). 'bed' = device-recorded room audio (audio_16bit*.wav, int16 = I2S word >> 16) used as background for mixing and as ambient negatives. Splits are by recording/time block, never by random window. Held-out blocks are NEVER used for training or threshold selection.

excluded_runs.20260926_213821_m1_smoke_warm: captured with Philips framing (1-bit misalignment, E-18) — not device-representative
excluded_runs.20260926_221709_m1_sessionA_cold: contains speaker S01 speech; S01 is the held-out test speaker

_bed_train_note: ambient_day c000 = 13:45-14:15 household audio (may include speaker S01 talking normally; never the keyword by instruction). Later ambient_day chunks are reserved: c001-c003 train in the final build, c004+ HELD-OUT for the false-activation test.
